CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 22, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:00 P.M. in City Hall Conference Room A.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Planning Manager; Kari Fowler, City Historic Preservation
  Planner

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – May 28, 2025
  •  Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the May 28, 2025, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Committee.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the May 28, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  COMMEMORATIVE HISTORIC PLAQUE PROGRAM
  •  This is a presentation on the options for how to proceed with the
  implementation of a Commemorative Historic Plaque Program.
  •  Recommended Action: It is recommended the Historic
  Preservation Commission receive the presentation on the options

  1
  10/22/2025
   for a Commemorative Historic Plaque Program; receive public
  comment; consider, discuss, and deliberate on the options for a
  Commemorative Historic Plaque Program; and then provide
  direction on their preference for a Commemorative Historic Plaque
  Program.
  •  Planning Manager Maia McCurley provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and
  sub-consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG),
  provided the presentation.
  •  The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was
  opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recommend City Council to adopt a Type 2
  Commemorative Historic Plaque Program per the City consultant’s
  presentation, and table a Type 1 Commemorative Historic Plaque
  Program recognizing placed-based history with no extant resources
  until a time when further consultation with an advocacy group has
  occurred to gauge their interest in participating in such a program.
  •  Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recommend a Type 2 Commemorative Historic Plaque
  Program to recognize locally designated historic resources (City of
  Alhambra Historic Landmarks and contributors to City of Alhambra
  Historic Districts), with participation not to be limited to properties
  with a Mills Act contract; and recommending the design of the
  plaque be rectangular (horizontal); have 2 size options (8”x10” and
  11”x14”) with the applicant determining their selected size in
  consultation with staff; to include basic property information (historic
  property name, year built or other significant date, architect, original
  owner, builder, architectural style); basic designation information
  (“Historic Landmark” or Historic District name, if applicable); and
  text only (no City seal or logo).
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Vice President
  Littlefield.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Littlefield, Amaro
  2
  10/22/2025
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  •  There were no public hearing items.

G.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Melissa Michelson commented on her removal from the Historic Preservation
  Commission and previous public comments she had shared at a City Council
  meeting. Ms. Michelson also commented on her tenure on the Historic
  Preservation Commission; public comments made by other Commissioners,
  members of the public, and Council members; and her interactions with City staff
  and fellow Commissioners.

H.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:18 P.M. to
  Wednesday, January 28, 2026, at 6:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Joyce Amaro
  President
